description: This shell script file contains test scenarios for verifying the functionality of a git diff utility, including setup of test data, applying diffs, and validating context lines and diff properties.

methods.name: commit_and_tag
methods.description: Creates a git commit with a specific tag after adding specified files.

methods.name: first_context_line
methods.description: Extracts the first line of context around a diff hunk from a diff file.

methods.name: last_context_line
methods.description: Retrieves the last line of context from a diff file.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Performs a diff check between file versions and verifies its application.
